@Vinnie Ω , to make it easy.

1. Go to ⁠2│verify-your-asset and then type: /verify add 
2. Press enter 
3. In the command line you will be prompted for your wallet address. 
4. Paste in your wallet address that holds the Cornucopias NFT. 
5. Press enter again. 
6. Hazel bot will ask you to send an amount of ADA. 
7. Copy this EXACT amount. 
8. Head over to your wallet that holds your NFTS and send to yourself the amount of ADA you've copied from the bot prompt. 
9. Once the transaction has been logged, hazel bot will state that you have been successfully verified. 
10. Wait for roles to drop. 

Bonus: IF you've used this bot to verify on other servers, you still need to run the /verify add command, but you do not need to send the ADA. After you've run the command the bot will say that you have been verified. After you see this, wait for the roles to drop. (edited)
